subject: math
question:
设 $A$ 是 $n$ 阶方阵， $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 是 $n$ 维向量，且

$$
\alpha_ {1} \neq 0, A \alpha_ {1} = \alpha_ {1}, A \alpha_ {2} = \alpha_ {1} + \alpha_ {2}, A \alpha_ {3} = \dot {\alpha} _ {2} + \alpha_ {3}.
$$

steps.text:
$\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性无关.

分析 所给条件可变形为 $(A - I)\alpha_{1} = 0$ ， $(A - I)\alpha_{2} = \alpha_{1}$ ， $(A - I)\alpha_{3} = \alpha_{2}$ ，对 $k_{1}\alpha_{1} + k_{2}\alpha_{2} + k_{3}\alpha_{3} = 0$ ，要证 $k_{1} = k_{2} = k_{3} = 0$ ，只需用 $A - I$ 左乘等式两边。

证明 由于 $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} A\alpha_{1} = \alpha_{1} \\ A\alpha_{2} = \alpha_{1} + \alpha_{2}, \\ A\alpha_{3} = \alpha_{2} + \alpha_{3} \end{array} \right.$ 则有

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} (A - I) \alpha_ {1} = 0 \\ (A - I) \alpha_ {2} = \alpha_ {1}. \\ (A - I) \alpha_ {3} = \alpha_ {2} \end{array} \right.\tag{①}
$$

由①式可得

$$
k _ {2} \alpha_ {1} + k _ {3} \alpha_ {2} = 0.\tag{③}
$$

再用 A-I 左乘上式两边，得 $k_{3}\alpha_{1}=0$ ，而 $\alpha_{1}\neq0$ ，所以 $k_{3}=0$ 。依次代入③，②式得 $k_{2}=0,\quad k_{1}=0$ 。即有 $k_{1}=k_{2}=k_{3}=0$ 。所以 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性无关。

cdps.prompt: 向量组问题宜用线性表示、秩、无关判定还是基/正交？

meta.syllabus_note: 矩阵作用条件下线性无关证明
meta.commentary:
评注 证明一个向量组线性无关的常用方法如下.

(1) 定义法: $k_{1} \alpha_{1} + k_{2} \alpha_{2} + \cdots + k_{s} \alpha_{s} = 0 \Leftrightarrow k_{1} = k_{2} = \cdots = k_{s} = 0$ .

(2) 方程组法：方程组 $x_{1}\alpha_{1} + x_{2}\alpha_{2} + \cdots + x_{s}\alpha_{s} = 0$ 只有零解.

(3) 矩阵的秩： $\operatorname{rank}(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s})=s$ ．特别地，若 $(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s})$ 是方阵，则 $\det(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s})\neq0$

(4) 反证法.

(5) 归纳法.
